Fatty Bear's Funpack.name: Fatty Bear's FunPack
Fatty Bear's Funpack.summary:
Fatty Bear's Fun Pack was Fatty Bear's final appearance as a solo character, but he still did made a cameo in Putt-Putt Saves The Zoo and was referenced in many games afterward.

Activities/games included Reversi, Go Fish, Lines and Boxes, Tangrams, and Coloring, all five of which reappeared in Putt-Putt & Fatty Bear's Activity Pack.

Lemmings.name: Lemmings
Lemmings.summary: The 3DO version of lemmings included a new 3d intro, sfx and music thanks to the newer hardware.

Sid Meier's C.P.U. Bach.name: Sid Meier's C.P.U. Bach
Sid Meier's C.P.U. Bach.summary:
C.P.U. Bach is an interactive music-generating program designed by Sid Meier and Jeff Briggs for the 3DO. It can create Baroque music in the style of Bach for various keyboard, wind, or string instruments and in a variety of forms (e.g., concerti, fugues, minuets, chorales). The compositions are then performed by the software with synchronous 3D graphics on screen showing the virtual instruments being played.

The name of the program is a pun on the initials of one of Bach's actual sons, C.P.E. Bach, and "CPU".

Twinkle Knights.name: Twinkle Knights
Twinkle Knights.summary: Twinkle Knights, is a card-based fighting game where your female opponents just happen to lose their clothes bit by bit if you win a round. The game extends its life by making each fight 5 rounds, and the computer manages to pull some good cards on you when you least expect it, extending its lifespan a bit.
